message: Hexadecimal literal `0x1F` is not supported in v0.1; write integers in decimal.
Float literal `1.` has no digits after the decimal point; floats need digits on both sides of the point.
String literal is not terminated; a string must end with `"` on the same line.
Color literal `#fff` has 3 hexadecimal digits; colors are `#RRGGBB` or `#RRGGBBAA`.
Block comment is not terminated; the `/*` here needs a matching `*/`.
